issues.description: The problem statement and UML specify that Milkable.messageOnMilk() should return a String (and the instructions show it returning the text "[Animal Type] [name] is milked"), but the solution repository defines Milkable.messageOnMilk() to return a boolean and the Seal and Goat implementations print the message and return true. This return-type mismatch contradicts the specification and will confuse students about the expected signature and behavior of messageOnMilk().
issues.suggestedFix: Align the Milkable API with the problem specification: change the Milkable interface to declare String messageOnMilk(), and update Seal and Goat to return the string "[Animal Type] [name] is milked" (instead of printing and returning boolean). Alternatively, if the intended design is to return boolean, update the problem statement and UML to specify boolean and adjust the textual instructions accordingly. Ensure the template Main usage (System.out.println(m.messageOnMilk())) and tests expect a String if choosing the first option.

issues.description: The problem statement (UML and instructions) specifies Milkable.messageOnMilk() should return a String (the printable message "[Animal Type] [name] is milked") and the template Main uses System.out.println(m.messageOnMilk()) expecting a String. In the solution repository, Milkable.messageOnMilk() is declared to return boolean and implementations (Goat, Seal) print the message internally and return true. This creates an API/identifier semantic mismatch: the same conceptual operation (producing the milk message) uses a different return type across artifacts, preventing students from mapping the required behavior to the provided implementation and tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the API across artifacts by changing Milkable.messageOnMilk() to return String (as specified in the problem). Update solution/interface to 'String messageOnMilk();' and modify Goat and Seal to return the message string (e.g., "Goat Buttinsky is milked") instead of printing and returning boolean. Ensure Main and any tests print the returned String.
